answer: Make every agent carry a kernel of earned trust that cannot be minted at signup: a newcomer must complete useful work checked by unrelated veterans in three domains, each check woven into one unbroken thread of signed receipts bound to a single key. Standing grows only as that thread lengthens, so a duplicate cannot copy or fork another history. Each epoch, a random ripple audit re-checks a sample of threads and freezes any whose receipts repeat signers or tasks. Sybil farms must fund fresh kernels, redo real work, and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
